title: tabledoc table (<schema>/<table>.yml)
description: The description of one table. The keys follow one entry of dbt's `models:`; keys dbt does not have sit at the same level. Types, nullability and row counts are not written here.

name.description: The table's name: the file's name, <name>.tabledoc.yml.

hidden.description: true keeps the table out of lists and search, such as a table only other tables read; default false.

sql.description: The SQL the table is made from, for a table dbt does not build.

documents.description: Paths of the table's documents, relative to the root. They go into the table's folder by file name; README.md is its guide. <name>.md beside the table file is its guide without being listed.

entity.description: The column is an identifier: its values come from this code system, such as corporate_number or city, so it joins with other columns of the same name.

dimension.description: A column to filter and group by. categorical: a column whose values, from a fixed set, tell what was counted or which kind a row is (an indicator, an industry, an age group, a sex); not a column of places or organizations (by code or by name) or true/false; a column of years is time. time: a column of dates or periods.

granularity.description: How fine a time dimension is: day, month, year, ...

asset.description: The value is the path of a file that belongs to the row.
